themeSection.title: Appearance & Color Theme
themeSection.desc: Choose between dark, light, or automated OS preference syncing.
themeSection.outageHighlightsDesc: Display shaded red background bands and indicators during power cuts and utility blackout intervals.

languageSection.title: Language & Localization
languageSection.desc: Select user interface language. Defaults to operating system display language.

profileSection.title: Active UPS Profile & Specifications
profileSection.desc: Calibrate hardware specifications to ensure precise runtime calculations and battery curves.

systemSection.title: System & Startup Integration
systemSection.desc: Configure how UPSED interacts with Windows background services and system tray.
systemSection.autostartDesc: Starts UPSED in the background automatically upon user login.
systemSection.autostartDevNotice: Autostart disabled during npm run tauri dev to avoid dev build conflicts.
systemSection.minimizeTrayTitle: Close Button Minimizes to System Tray
systemSection.minimizeTrayDesc: Keeps UPS background monitoring active in the tray when the window is closed.
systemSection.startMinimizedDesc: Opens the application silently in the notification tray without showing the main window on boot.

pollingSection.title: Telemetry Polling Frequency
pollingSection.desc: Rate at which Q1/QPIGS queries are dispatched to the serial port controller.
pollingSection.pollWarning: High-frequency polling (<5s) may increase serial port traffic on low-baud RS-232 interfaces.

downsamplingSection.title: Historical Graph Resolution & Downsampling
downsamplingSection.desc: Adjust the maximum telemetry points loaded into charts to balance rendering performance and minute-by-minute waveform detail.

bridgeSection.title: OS Native Battery Bridge
bridgeSection.desc: Exposes connected UPS as a virtual native battery to Windows OS.
bridgeSection.optInNotice: Complies with Agent Safety Invariant: Disabled by default. Only enabled upon explicit opt-in.
bridgeSection.bridgeToggle: Emulate Laptop Battery in Windows Taskbar

notificationsSection.title: Notifications & Hardware Alarms
notificationsSection.desc: Configure how hardware state transitions and warning bitmasks are delivered.
notificationsSection.osNotifDesc: Displays native toast notifications when the app is minimized or out of focus.
notificationsSection.inAppNotifDesc: Displays custom dark-themed toast popups within the application.

navigationGuard.title: Unsaved Changes
navigationGuard.subtitle: Pending preference modifications
navigationGuard.message: You have unsaved preferences in Settings. Would you like to save them before leaving this page?
navigationGuard.infoNote: Discarding will restore all settings and hardware parameters to their last saved state.

toasts.discardSuccess: Settings restored to last saved state.

securitySection.title: Security & Access Control
securitySection.desc: Manage administrator credentials that protect write operations and live power controls.
securitySection.sessionActiveDesc: Write commands and power controls unlocked until session expires after 15m idle.
securitySection.notAuthenticatedDesc: Log in to modify persistent hardware configuration or power states.
securitySection.notConfiguredDesc: Set up administrator credentials to guard hardware safety gates.
securitySection.resetDesc: Clear administrator credentials and return to initial setup state.
